title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A — Cernus runtime crosswalk
description: Annex A controls Cernus can evidence from runtime facts. Supporting evidence for an ISMS, not certification.

controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.statement: Technical vulnerabilities are identified and treated in a timely way. Checked: no open finding past its remediation window.

controls.title: Configuration Management
controls.statement: Configurations are established and monitored. Checked: no open misconfiguration findings.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.statement: Systems are monitored for anomalous behaviour and known weaknesses. Checked: latest scan within the freshness window.

controls.title: Installation of Software on Operational Systems
controls.statement: Software on operational systems is managed. Checked: deployed images carry stored SBOMs.

controls.title: Secure Development Life Cycle
controls.statement: Development follows a secure life cycle. Checked: the latest deployment passed its automated test gate.

controls.title: Secure Coding
controls.statement: Secure coding principles are applied. Checked: the latest deployment passed the SAST gate.

controls.title: Outsourced Development / Third-Party Components
controls.statement: Third-party components are reviewed. Checked: the latest deployment passed the dependency scan gate.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.statement: Changes are subject to change management. Checked: the latest deployment has a change id and passed delivery gates.
